faq.q1: What is Fashion-Web and who is it for?
faq.a1: Fashion-Web is a curated collection of 81 ready-to-use fashion website templates across 8 brand categories — from Muslimah & Modest Wear and Boutique Luxury to Footwear, Bags & Accessories. Built for fashion brands that want a professional online presence without the hassle.
faq.q2: How do I preview a template?
faq.a2: Click any template card in the Collection section. The preview shows the desktop and mobile versions side by side — switch between Desktop, Mobile, or Both modes. Want to see it live? Press "Open Original Demo" to open the real template site in a new tab.
faq.q3: Are the templates responsive on all devices?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Every template is 100% ready to use and fully responsive — looking sharp on desktop, tablet, and smartphone. Check it yourself via the Mobile preview mode on any card.
faq.q4: Can I pick a template matching my brand category?
faq.a4: Yes. Eight dedicated brand categories are available — Muslimah & Modest Wear, Boutique Luxury, Casual & Streetwear, Uniforms & Workwear, Traditional & Ethnic Wear, Activewear, Kids & Baby, and Footwear, Bags & Accessories. Use the category filters or the search box to find the perfect match.
faq.q5: Do I need to know how to code to use a template?
faq.a5: No. All templates are standalone — no frameworks, no backend. Just fill in your product photos and brand info. Need more tailoring? Our team can handle the personalization for you.
faq.a6: Click the "Consult Us" or "Choose Website Package" button. Tell us about your fashion brand needs, and we will recommend the most suitable template and the next steps.
cta.h2: Ready to Place Your Brand in the Right Home?
cta.p: Consult about your fashion website needs today — free, no commitment, with template recommendations that truly match your brand character.
